messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
The ATP (men’s) and WTA (women’s) rankings are the standard measures of “top‑ranked” tennis players.

| Category | Current #1 (as of the latest ATP/WTA rankings) |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------|
| **Men’s singles** | **Novak Djokovic** (Serbia) – he has held the world No. 1 spot for a record‑tying 372 weeks and remains the top‑ranked player on the ATP tour. |
| **Women’s singles** | **Iga Świątek** (Poland) – she has been the world No. 1 on the WTA tour for a record‑tying 200+ weeks and is the current top‑ranked player in women’s tennis. |

If you’re looking for the overall “best” player regardless of gender, the ATP and WTA rankings are separate, so the top male and top female players are listed above.
